Actual MCP path and module bodies expose the reviewed module/unit/summary links. The credential/course bridge is ancestry only, never answer evidence.

Doc parents are immediate self-paced training or summary references: vector type/distance/search links, named CREATE VECTOR INDEX, VECTORPROPERTY, VECTOR_NORMALIZE, CONTAINSTABLE, TOP and RANK. No documentation-to-documentation approval was substituted.
Source registry, frozen manifest, raw MCP retrieval timestamps and shared integration source/registry records were checked for exact agreement.
limitations: No new retrieval or online-availability check was made; freshness is relative to the exact frozen evidence, not always-current claims.
Assessment/exercise links in module indexes were not followed or used as evidence.
Latest vector features remain Preview and Azure/version/rollout scoped. Generic earlier-index post-filter/read-only teaching was not applied to latest indexes.
VECTOR_SEARCH has a faulty multi-key ordering workflow sample; explicit repeated requirements, errors and subquery examples determine the reviewed claim.
The hybrid training sample lacks query-level TOP ordering and uses broad BM25/performance language. Only its supported fusion pattern is retained.
No selected question uses Not applicable. Mathematical reasoning inside an actual SQL feature question does not remove that feature lifecycle claim.

duplicateReview.scope: Bounded manual semantic comparison of selected items and the listed actual comparator texts, not a fresh all-credential semantic audit or review of technical-held IDs.

comparisons.reason: Screen intent, prefix grammar and configured full-text key plus ranked eligibility are different facts.
Choosing semantic input fields is different from selecting phrase versus meaning query behavior.
Native float32 byte/dimension arithmetic differs from modality and sequential window/latency selection despite conjunction-shaped choices.
Metadata counts, norm arithmetic, compatible model-space rollout and storage budgets have different required invariants.
Negative-dot sign/geometry differs from exactness recall and index column/metric compatibility.
Both involve early caps but only 014 repairs a separate full-text unique-key mapping and deterministic relevance selection; 047 diagnoses earlier-index post-filter behavior.
Global-document versus category aggregation, paired latest-syntax migration and window/query TOP scope repairs require different reasoning.
Physical strategy override differs from compatibility and syntax, but its only named forcing hint and prerequisite-destroying alternatives make 022 too cued for the authored level.
Subset ordering, integer/NULL evaluation, reciprocal arithmetic, candidate inclusion and gap-free ties are different facts, not cosmetic variants.

duplicateReview.warningDisposition: 013 negative wording expresses token-prefix inclusion/exclusion; 020 pronouns refer to explicit model/metric inputs; 022 negatives express benchmark boundaries but construction cues cause a hold; 023 scope references resolve to named CTEs. No lexical flag was treated as semantic proof.

staticValidation.method: Independent arithmetic and stipulated relational/token countermodels only. These JavaScript calculations do not execute T-SQL, a word breaker, index creation, model inference or any live performance test.
staticValidation.globalPoolCountercontext: One global pool can contain A=12, B=8, C=0; independent per-category pools can instead contain 20 from each populated category. This is a hypothetical population distinction, not measured ANN output.
